question.tr: Tahmin edilen fiyat bandına göre ayrı kalibre edilen %90 aralık her bantta hedefi tutar mı?
question.en: Does a 90% interval calibrated separately per predicted-price band hold its target in every band?

data_slice: load_clean(): the 29,988 unique TR-plated listings the model is trained on, with this run's LightGBM OOF predictions and their fold column (cv.load_oof, the model's own 5 folds).
split: kfold_oof, cross-conformal: for each of the model's 5 folds the interval's q comes only from the other 4 folds' OOF residuals and is applied to that fold, so no listing's own residual calibrates its interval. Bands = quartiles of the predicted price over all listings (a function of the predictions only, no labels).
target: Coverage of the 90% interval expm1(log1p(pred) ± q) in each predicted-price quartile band: share of listings whose price is inside. q = the ceil((n+1)·0.9)-th smallest |log1p(price) − log1p(pred)| of the calibration part (finite-sample conformal quantile). Two arms on the same folds: global (one q per fold, all bands) and Mondrian (one q per band per fold, from that band's calibration residuals). Also published: overall coverage and the median interval width per band in ₺ and as % of the prediction, for both arms.

statement.tr: Tahmin edilen fiyatın dört çeyrek bandında ayrı ayrı kalibre edilen (Mondrian, çapraz kalibreli) %90 aralığın kapsaması her bantta %88 ile %92 arasında.
statement.en: A 90% interval calibrated separately in each of the four predicted-price quartile bands (Mondrian, cross-calibrated) covers between 88% and 92% in every band.

hypotheses.accept_if: every one of the 4 bands has Mondrian coverage >= 88 and <= 92 (percent)
hypotheses.reject_if: any band has Mondrian coverage < 88 or > 92 (percent)

out_of_scope: Changing the served interval (encoders.pkl CONFORMAL_Q) or the live API
Bands on anything but the predicted price (segment, age, number of comparables)
Conformalized quantile regression (CQR) or other interval methods
